event_timeline.event: Scheduled telemetry workflow completed its report and commit steps; main commit f97ac7a changed only the generated report timestamp, followed by successful Pages deployment 41148264821.
Scheduled Cross Analysis run 41157339221 pushed main commit 7a780de and triggered successful Pages deployment 41157349809; this repeated the same pattern one hour later.
Scheduled Cross Analysis again pushed main commit b375954 and triggered successful Pages deployment 41161885309. XRP and BTC sentiment-shift windows each had zero observations.
Scheduler Tick fired zero of one queued entries and performed a no-op push, while retaining main-write and workflow-dispatch capability.
Draft PR #1391 opened from current main b375954; exact-head CI passed 349 tests plus 8 subtests and fail-closed gate passed with merge disabled.

findings.statement: Cross Analysis run 41161874626 caused main commit b375954; the job log records git push from 7a780de to b375954. The only changed file was sentiment_shift.json.
findings.disconfirming_evidence: No material disconfirmation; the run log and commit parent/path diff agree.

findings.statement: The XRP and BTC sentiment-shift detector had zero observations in both recent and prior windows. Its output is null and NOT_EVALUATED, not a zero or positive/negative market signal.
findings.disconfirming_evidence: The entity sentiment profiler separately printed mention counts and scores, but those are distinct derived knowledge-base outputs and do not supply the missing shift-window observations.

findings.statement: GitHub Pages build and deploy run 41161885309 succeeded on main head b375954 immediately after the scheduled Cross Analysis push.
findings.disconfirming_evidence: The Pages run is downstream of the push; it does not prove Cross Analysis directly invoked a deployment command.

findings.statement: The scheduled telemetry workflow committed f97ac7a to main at 00:05:51Z, changing only the generated report timestamp, and its push was followed by successful Pages deployment 41148264821.
findings.disconfirming_evidence: The workflow itself contains no direct deployment step; the Pages deployment is an automatic downstream effect.

findings.statement: PR #1391 is open, draft, mergeable and unmerged on current main base b375954. Exact-head CI passed 349 tests plus 8 subtests and the fail-closed gate passed with merging disabled.
findings.disconfirming_evidence: No production workflow execution of the proposed read-only version has occurred because the PR is unmerged.

findings.statement: The open PR inventory contains 166 PRs: 156 drafts, 10 ready, 164 main-based, 163 stale-main-base, one current-main-base and two non-main-base.
findings.disconfirming_evidence: This is a point-in-time inventory; base refs can change.

findings.statement: Scheduler Tick run 41161577082 fired zero entries and made no main change, but its commit/push step executed and its write/dispatch capability remains.
findings.disconfirming_evidence: The latest run was a no-op; this does not establish future queue changes will be harmless.

findings.statement: Repeated scheduled main commits create avoidable Pages deployments even when the generated change is only a timestamp or the underlying sentiment sample is empty. Artifact-only outputs and PR-based publication are the safer architecture.
findings.disconfirming_evidence: A deployment may be operationally intended for some content changes; the concern is automatic deployment for zero-sample or telemetry-only changes without a review boundary.

findings.statement: The exact main branch protection rules and any bypass actor remain unknown. The branch API reports protected=true, while the detailed protection endpoint is inaccessible through the available integration.
findings.disconfirming_evidence: Successful workflow pushes prove a write occurred, not which protection rule or bypass mechanism allowed it.

safety_prs.purpose: Read-only cross-analysis and legacy accuracy quarantine
Restrict scheduler to an allowlisted validation workflow; queue still has a main-write path
Read-only merge queue and deployment gate

limitations: Main still has scheduled Cross Analysis, daily signal-accuracy, Scheduler Tick and telemetry workflow write paths because their remediation PRs remain unmerged.

PRs #1386, #1388 and #1390 are based on 7a780de, one main commit behind b375954; no changed-path overlap with the b375954 timestamp-only sentiment file was found, but fresh merge-result validation is still required.
Scheduler Tick still has contents:write and actions:write capability; the latest run was a no-op.
The detailed branch-protection rules, bypass actor, GitHub security alerts and dependency vulnerability status are not accessible through the tested read actions.
Full repository CI and dependency vulnerability scanning remain NOT_RUN.
Only GitHub access and the current ChatGPT session are verified; the other eight platforms remain unauthenticated and untested.
